_comment: Coldsteel Heart's ETB colour is LOCKED PER OBJECT (CardParams::etb_choose_color, stored in
Permanent::chosen_color as an as-enters REPLACEMENT effect -- CR 614, no stack).
USER-FOUND, 2026-09-08, hand-playing Snow references: 'Coldsteel heart is also not asking for a
colour. That is kind of an issue.' Before this, the card was modelled as a plain WUBRG rock --
each tap free to make any of five colours -- the Cavern of Souls / Unclaimed Territory ETB-choice
simplification. That is over-permissive IN THE ENGINE'S FAVOUR: a real Heart is locked, so a
three-colour deck running four of them carries colour-screw risk the engine never faced.
THIS IS THE NEGATIVE HALF. Board = two Coldsteel Hearts both pinned GREEN + a Snow-Covered
Forest ({G}). There is NO blue source anywhere. Ice-Fang Coatl costs {G}{U}, so it is UNPAYABLE:
three mana on board, all of it green. Under the old model either Heart would simply produce the
{U} and the cast would be legal, so this fixture verdicts `accept` on the pre-fix engine and
`illegal` on the fixed one -- i.e. it is DISCRIMINATING, not merely passing.
Its twin coldsteel_heart_color_honored.json flips ONE Heart to BLUE on an otherwise identical
board and must verdict `accept`. The pair brackets the boundary in both directions: a locked
colour is really PAYABLE, and a colour the permanent did not choose is really UNAVAILABLE. The
